title: Algebraic independence over finite fields admits AM and coAM protocols

standard_prerequisites.name: Affine/projective algebraic geometry, arithmetic circuits and space complexity
standard_prerequisites.statement: Original prerequisite statements/citations and full source-local fiber, projection, curve and circuit constructions retained.
standard_prerequisites.use: No collector reproof or field/complexity strengthening. Original input encodings and finite-field scope remain explicit.

core_obligations: The authors build complementary algebraic-independence protocols from quantitative polynomial-map image and fiber-size gaps, including zero-dimensional fibers, large/small preimages and finite-field point estimates. Complete local constructions and protocol analysis retained, without inferring a deterministic polynomial-time test.
